name: Residency-octree traversal for multiple channels
definition: An octree traversal algorithm that handles multiple volume channels by tracking empty and homogeneous nodes per channel, skipping nodes only when all channels are empty or homogeneous, and determining resolution levels per channel.
summary: This method extends residency-based octree traversal to handle multiple volume channels simultaneously by skipping nodes only when all active channels are empty or homogeneous, ensuring no visible data is missed.
